create_Task_subclass: create a subclass of Task that implements forward_fn, get_gradients, and evaluate methods
build_forward_fn: build a forward_fn that runs the model forward pass and constructs Haiku modules for point track prediction
run_get_gradients: run get_gradients to compute gradients for the task's loss function with Haiku params and state
test_evaluate: test evaluate to measure task performance on a downstream benchmark with a given mode
review_SharedModule_Protocol: review the SharedModule Protocol defining the forward pass interface for shared Haiku modules
